rules.applies_when: project structure is initialized organized extended or audited
actions: classify NEW ORGANIZE EXTEND or AUDIT
reject mismatch between requested and actual state
load no unrelated product lifecycle rules
acceptance: empty project alone may use NEW
existing project is not silently migrated
ordinary development yields no directory operations
rules.failure_policy: remain read-only until mode is resolved

actions: create only four core directories and current needed branch
acceptance: no optional empty tree or automatic .gitkeep
placeholders are not presented as real project facts
rules.failure_policy: stop before partial initialization on conflict

acceptance: every inventoried root item has one disposition
internal docs/tests/tools/build remain inside source project
different-content collision is unresolved not overwritten
rules.failure_policy: preserve source and pause conflicting branch

actions: compare file count total bytes and per-file SHA-256
check links LFS submodules and permissions as applicable
run original entry from project container
acceptance: counts bytes and all required hashes match
original required entry remains usable or is explicitly unverified
rules.failure_policy: retain source; never clean after failed verification

rules.applies_when: original material would be deleted after migration
acceptance: recovery exists and prior verification still matches
rules.failure_policy: do not delete and report retained source

rules.applies_when: large or immutable artifacts are stored
actions: apply 10 MiB evaluation and 50 MiB ordinary-Git exclusion thresholds
record version size hash and source
acceptance: file at least 50 MiB is not newly committed to ordinary Git history
external/LFS object is retrievable and hash-correct
editable master and read-only snapshot roles are distinct
rules.failure_policy: retain local source and block cleanup/publication
